reason: Provides DeepSeek Harness Desktop integration for WSL workspaces, routing file browsing, editing, and shell execution to Linux distributions; the README explicitly documents Full access requirements and command execution.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 提供 WSL 工作区集成，将文件浏览、编辑和 Shell 操作路由到选定的 Linux 发行版。
summaries.en: Integrates WSL workspaces with DeepSeek Harness Desktop by routing file browsing, editing, and shell operations to a selected Linux distribution.

capabilities: Reads and writes files through WSL UNC paths
Executes commands in a selected WSL distribution and Linux working directory
Provides model tools for listing distributions, creating workspaces, and running commands
